study: RCCG Tabernacle of Praise — Strategic Identity Study 04
checks: Six territories each contain two nonidentical vector studies; four advance and eight show specific set-aside reasons
All displayed studies preserve editable source geometry and transforms; shortlisted art and full-name lockups use vector outlines with licensed type disclosed
Draft status and open decisions remain visible; RCCG is reserved with a clearly missing-asset label; no palette stage or mandatory historical finalist is introduced
All six territory filters work with keyboard activation and return the correct two studies; all-ideas restores twelve
Artwork dialogs trap keyboard focus, close with Escape, and restore the opener; all four concept tablists support arrows, Home, and End
Every large stage and overview reverses; size proofs use actual 64/32/24/16px boxes and 320/240px full-name widths, with compact/full-wordmark limits disclosed
All twenty primary-artwork, horizontal, stacked, paper, and signage downloads are valid draft SVGs and retain source geometry
Review selections, notes and viewing mode survive reload; downloaded JSON records no identity approval and clearing removes local notes
All four proof panels and artwork dialogs fit 1440/768/390/320px screens without page or dialog horizontal overflow
Self-contained HTML renders all art with every network route blocked; filters, reversal, dialogs, feedback export and all twenty SVG downloads still work
The online study has no JavaScript errors or remote asset requests; every exported SVG parses successfully
limits: Behavior, geometry transfer and delivery checks only. Human visual interpretation and small-size recognition remain review questions. No brand approval, theological endorsement or trademark clearance is implied.
